text:
### Escalate to Head of Operations If:
- Process blocked >5 business days
- Technical system issue preventing update
- Multiple accounts with conflicting requirements
- Regulatory query related to address change  
---
name: Chunk 48/52

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Head of Operations Escalation
raw_entities.description: Escalation tier for address change process issues that cannot be resolved at frontline level. Triggered when process is blocked beyond 5 business days, technical system issues prevent updates, multiple accounts have conflicting requirements, or regulatory queries arise related to address changes.
context: Escalate to Head of Operations If:
Regulatory query related to address change

raw_entities.name: Process Blockage Duration Check
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that triggers escalation to Head of Operations if the address change process remains blocked for more than 5 business days without resolution.

raw_entities.name: Technical System Issue Detection
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that triggers escalation when a technical system issue prevents the address update from being completed in the system.

raw_entities.name: Conflicting Account Requirements Check
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that triggers escalation when multiple accounts associated with the same customer have conflicting address change requirements that cannot be reconciled at frontline level.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Query Detection
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that triggers escalation to Head of Operations when a regulatory query or inquiry is received in relation to the address change process.
context: Regulatory query related to address change

raw_entities.name: Address Change
raw_entities.description: Customer address update process subject to escalation procedures when specific operational or regulatory conditions are triggered.
context: Escalate to Head of Operations If:
